info.name: AutoManage Pro DMS - Complete REST API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive, production-ready Postman collection for AutoManage Pro DMS Spring Boot backend.
Includes automated JWT authentication capture, realistic payloads, query filters, and role-based endpoints.
